name: KaKi
greetingText: I really like your name btw!
wishText: You make my heart skip a beat!

loveNotes.title: Remember when...
loveNotes.message: We laughed until our stomachs hurt? Every moment with you is a treasure! 💕

loveNotes.title: You are...
loveNotes.message: The reason I smile every single day. Your presence makes everything better! ✨

loveNotes.title: I love how...
loveNotes.message: You make ordinary days extraordinary. You're my favorite adventure! 🌟

loveNotes.title: Forever grateful...
loveNotes.message: For having you in my life. You're my best friend and my love! 💗

paragraphs: Every day with you feels like a beautiful dream I never want to wake up from. You've brought so much joy, laughter, and love into my life.
Thank you for being my partner, my best friend, and my greatest adventure. Here's to many more Valentine's Days together!
